caption:
How to write a week of social media captions with one AI prompt

Instead of staring at a blank caption box every day, give AI your week once.

Copy this:

"I run [BUSINESS]. This week: [3–5 THINGS HAPPENING]. Write 5 captions, Mon–Fri, under 40 words each, each with a different job: behind the scenes, tip, customer question, product, invite. Sound like me: [PASTE 1 OLD CAPTION]. Use only facts I gave you."

I tried it for a sample florist's week: winter stems, a wedding, holiday orders, a wreath workshop. Five captions came back, each doing a different job, none inventing a sale or a "last few spots".

That last line of the prompt matters. Without it, AI tends to fill gaps with things that sound good but aren't true.
